Sets the number of times to retry the request if retrieving the
response fails for any reason.
Default: 0 (only try once)

Sets a header to add to the HTTP request.
The configuration can specify any number of HTTPHeader
elements, and the module will provide each of the specified
headers with the request.
There is no default for this option. If no HTTPHeader option is
included, the module provides a standard set of headers.
